The Spice House Restaurant at Cassia Cottage Phu Quoc sits on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo and quietly outrates half the island. Expect solid Vietnamese and international dishes, a calm garden setting, and prices that stay in the $15-30 range per person. No chaos. No tourist-trap menu.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
